title: Source-linked intake decisions for external implementation lessons

license.provenance_statement: The repository-local licensed-surface audit records the pinned source revision, package version, and MIT identity; this intake does not independently relicense or recertify the source.

evidence.claim: The audited search primitive is bounded and returns stable IDs, native scores, content, and provenance without recall-stat mutation.

lessons.extracted_generic_invariant: Provider recall is a bounded advisory read and must not mutate provider state, host authority, or final context.

target.mapping: Choose an adapter-visible recall primitive only when its read semantics preserve the provider-neutral no-mutation contract.

source_assumptions.assumption: The pinned source's search primitive avoids the recall-stat and session-cache effects present in its retrieve primitive.

neutral_regression_tests.proves: The provider-neutral recall contract remains a bounded advisory read and forbids provider mutation authority and direct context injection.

code_use.note: Only the generic invariant and the audited operation choice are accepted; no external implementation code is copied by this intake.

decision.rationale: The audited operation shape preserves the already accepted provider-neutral recall semantics while leaving source-specific dispatch and result adaptation behind the concrete adapter.

license.provenance_statement: The repository-local licensed-surface audit records the pinned source revision, package version, and MIT identity; this intake does not independently relicense or recertify the source.

evidence.claim: The audited retrieve path writes session cache and increments recall statistics, so it is not a provider-neutral advisory read.

lessons.extracted_generic_invariant: A provider recall primitive that mutates usage or session state cannot satisfy a no-mutation advisory-read capability.

target.mapping: Reject operation-name similarity when the candidate primitive has effects forbidden by the target capability.

source_assumptions.assumption: The pinned source's retrieve operation has session-cache and usage-stat effects that are not part of the provider recall contract.

code_use.note: The source-specific operation mapping is rejected and no external implementation code is copied.

decision.rationale: A similarly named source operation is not sufficient evidence that its effects match the target capability.
decision.rejection_rationale: The audited retrieve path mutates session and usage state, which violates the generic bounded advisory-read invariant and would weaken the common contract.
